Home.hero_subtitle: Cargo Posted. Right Transport. Deal Closed.
Home.hero_body: The digital marketplace that connects shippers and transporters in one place. Artificial Intelligence finds the right transport for every load — and vice versa. Post your cargo, negotiate, track your freight in real time, and receive payment securely, without intermediaries or unnecessary complexity.
Home.product_demo_desc: Browse representative listings from the NexCargo marketplace. Create an account to interact with real cargo opportunities.
Home.how_step_shipper_1_desc: Publish origin, destination, cargo type, weight and scheduling details.
Home.how_step_shipper_2_desc: Transporters discover your cargo and submit competitive offers.
Home.how_step_shipper_3_desc: Review offers, accept the best fit, and proceed to booking.
Home.how_step_transporter_1_desc: Browse available loads matching your route and vehicle capacity.
Home.how_step_transporter_2_desc: Present competitive offers on cargo that fits your network.
Home.how_step_transporter_3_desc: Confirm bookings, execute transport and complete delivery.
Home.for_shipper_desc: Publish cargo with full route and schedule details. Receive offers from qualified transporters, compare options, and proceed through structured booking workflows — all within one platform.
Home.for_transporter_desc: Discover cargo loads that match your routes and vehicle capacity. Submit competitive offers, participate in the booking workflow, and manage transporter operations — all in one place.
Home.feature_listings_desc: Publish and manage cargo with full route, weight, scheduling and vehicle requirements.
Home.feature_matching_desc: Connects cargo requirements with suitable transport capacity based on route, capacity and reliability.
Home.feature_tracking_desc: Shipment visibility through connected GPS tracking sources and operational milestone updates.
Home.feature_payment_desc: Payment workflows supported through integrated external financial services, consistent with NexCargo's No-Custody model.
Home.feature_ai_desc: AI-supported decision assistance for freight matching, routing suggestions and operational optimisation.
Home.feature_documents_desc: Documents integrated into cargo, booking, contract and operational workflows including e-delivery orders and compliance records.
Home.feature_notifications_desc: Operational communication throughout the shipment lifecycle — from posting to delivery confirmation.
Home.feature_multilang_desc: Full Portuguese and English interface supporting Mozambique and regional logistics operations.
Home.trust_no_custody_desc: NexCargo connects marketplace participants but does not operate the transport itself. We are a coordination layer, not a carrier.
Home.trust_responsibility_desc: Transport execution remains with the Transporter. NexCargo provides the marketplace infrastructure — the vehicle belongs to the operator.
Home.trust_no_custody_funds_desc: NexCargo does not directly hold customer funds. Financial workflows are designed around regulated banking partners as part of our architectural model.
Home.trust_region_desc: Built for Mozambique's logistics challenges with Portuguese-native interface and SADC regional design.
Home.moz_title: Built in Mozambique. Designed for the region.
Home.moz_desc: NexCargo was created to address the unique logistics challenges of Mozambique and the wider SADC region. Our platform supports Portuguese-language operations, understands local routing patterns, and is designed for cross-border freight movement across Southern Africa.
Home.moz_sadc: Designed for future SADC corridor expansion
Home.final_section_title: Ready to move your first cargo?
Home.final_shipper_line: Publish your cargo and reach qualified transporters.
Home.final_transporter_line: Discover new freight opportunities along your routes.
Home.footer_brand_desc: A neutral freight marketplace built for Mozambique and the SADC region.
